column2: Moses and Israel's elders command observance, while the quoted command retains the singular I of the speaker.
Crossing the Jordan introduces setting up large stones and plastering them; the repeated plaster wording remains.
All the words of this law go on the stones, with the two references to the God of the fathers and the milk-and-honey land retained.
The selected mountain is Gaibal, represented by traditional Ebal, not substituted with Gerizim.
The stone altar must have no iron laid upon its stones, preserving the explicit material restriction.
Whole stones and whole burnt offerings remain separate descriptions of altar material and offerings.
The sacrifice of deliverance is followed by eating, being filled and rejoicing; none of the three actions is omitted.
The writing is to convey all this law very plainly, preserving the emphatic clarity requirement.
Moses and the Levitical priests address all Israel, with silence and hearing preceding the declaration of becoming God's people.
Hearing the divine voice and doing all commandments and ordinances remain coordinated obligations.
The speech introduction identifies Moses, the people and that day before the mountain assignments.
Gerizim's blessing group remains Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph and Benjamin in the selected order.
Ebal's curse group remains Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan and Naphtali, complementary to the six in 27:12.
The Levites speak to all Israel with a loud voice, setting up the communal responses.
The graven and molten image, craftsman's hands and secret placement are all retained; genoito is represented by So be it.
Dishonouring either father or mother is followed by the complete people's response.
The neighbour's boundaries are not to be moved; the repeated response remains fully written.
Leading a blind person astray on the road is the cursed action, not blindness itself.
Perverted judgment concerns sojourner, orphan and widow, with all three groups retained.
The father's wife and father's covering remain the selected relational terms, rather than replacing covering with a different explicit noun.
Any beast keeps the unrestricted animal category in this prohibition; no narrowing to cattle is introduced.
The sister may be related through father or mother; the English makes the kinship relation explicit without restricting it to full siblings.
Both mother-in-law and wife's sister clauses, each with its own communal response, remain within this stored unit.
Treacherously preserves dolo rather than substituting a merely private or secret setting.
The gifts are a bribe to kill an innocent person in this context; the complete communal response remains.
column3: Innocent life compresses the Greek life-of-innocent-blood expression; fuller idiom review should consider whether its blood imagery needs explicit retention.

column2: Every person, all the law's words, continued adherence and actual doing remain explicit in the final curse.
The selected Jordan-crossing introduction remains before the conditional hearing and doing that lead to elevation above the nations.
The blessings come and find the hearer; find is retained rather than harmonized to the curses' overtake verb.
The paired city and field blessings retain the repeated blessed are you.
Womb, land, cattle herds and sheep flocks remain in sequence; cattle here represents the specific bovine noun.
Storehouses and reserves follow the selected Greek, without substituting basket and kneading bowl.
column3: The precise scope of enkataleimmata as reserves or things left over remains a lexical question.

column2: Coming in precedes going out in the blessing pair, unlike the reversed order in 28:19.
The optative blessing and the enemy's one-way approach/seven-way flight remain, with enemies crushed before the addressee.
Blessing concerns storerooms and everything undertaken in the given land; the petition-like verb form remains.
Establishment as a holy people refers to the oath to the fathers and is conditioned on hearing and walking.
All nations see the divine name called upon Israel and consequently fear the people.
The sequence is womb, land and livestock offspring. Revise generic ktenon from cattle to livestock, distinguishing it from the bovine term at 28:4.
Heaven is the good treasury opened for seasonal rain; both lending without borrowing and ruling without being ruled remain.
Head versus tail and above versus beneath express the paired reversals; restore then for the selected tote in the second pair.
Neither right nor left deviation is permitted toward serving other gods; the stated direction and purpose remain.
The negative condition introduces curses that come and overtake, distinct from the blessings' find in 28:2.
The repeated city and field curse corresponds to the earlier blessing without compressing either location.
Storehouses and reserves retain the same provisional vocabulary as 28:5 in the reversed outcome.
Womb, land, cattle herds and sheep flocks are repeated in the curse, with cattle still specifically bovine.
Going out precedes coming in here; the order is not normalized to 28:6.
Want, famine and wasting lead to destruction; the concluding first-person Me remains despite the preceding third-person divine reference.
Death itself is made to cleave to the people until consumption from the inherited land.
All seven afflictions remain, including slaughter for phonos and pallor for ochra, rather than replacing them with a familiar alternate list.
column3: Destitution for aporia and the precise clinical scope of the disease terms remain provisional lexical choices, not modern diagnoses.

column2: Bronze heaven and iron earth preserve the selected materials and their positions above and below.
Dust replaces rain and earth descends from heaven, with both wearing away and destruction retained.
The one-way approach and seven-way flight now concern Israel, followed by dispersion across all kingdoms.
The dead become food for birds and beasts, with nobody to drive them off; the Greek shifts to plural your dead.
The selected ulcer location is the buttocks, followed by grievous scab and itching with inability to heal.
column3: The anatomical and medical terms are retained as traditional contextual renderings without diagnostic identification.

column2: Madness, blindness and bewilderment of mind remain three distinct afflictions.
Noonday groping contrasts with darkness; the third-person failure to prosper the ways is retained, followed by wronging, plunder and lack of help.
Wife, house and vineyard each have an expected benefit denied; another man having the wife remains the selected wording.
Calf, donkey and sheep have different losses, with no eating, no restoration and no helper retained in their respective clauses.
Sons and daughters go to another nation; wasting eyes and a powerless hand express the parents' helplessness.
An unknown nation consumes produce and labour, while wronging and crushing continue all the days.
The sights actually seen are the cause of madness, preserving the connection to the preceding losses.
Knees and legs are specified before the sole-to-crown extent and inability to be healed.
The selected rulers are plural, not a harmonized singular king; unfamiliar exile and service to wooden and stone gods follow.
Riddle, parable and tale preserve the selected threefold description of Israel among the nations.
Much seed carried out yields little brought in because the locust consumes it.
Planting and tending the vineyard bring neither drinking nor rejoicing, with the worm as the stated consumer.
Olive trees throughout the borders give no oil for anointing because the olives fall away.
Sons and daughters are born but go into captivity, explaining why they shall not be yours.
Blight consumes both the trees and land produce; it is not replaced by the locust from 28:38.
The repeated up/up and down/down are conveyed by higher and higher and lower and lower, keeping the reciprocal reversal.
The sojourner lends while Israel cannot lend to him; the head/tail reversal answers the earlier blessing.
Curses come, pursue and overtake until destruction because the voice and commanded ordinances were not obeyed.
Signs and wonders remain plural and extend to the people's seed for ever.
column3: The repeated en soi/en to spermati can be rendered in or among as well as contextually upon; inherited upon remains provisional here, unlike the personal sin formula.

column2: The failure to serve with gladness and a good heart is set against abundance of all things.
Service to enemies occurs in hunger, thirst, nakedness and total want, and the iron collar lasts until destruction.
The distant nation comes like an eagle's swoop, with its speech unintelligible to the addressee.
Shameless countenance leads to no regard for the aged and no mercy for the young, preserving both contrasts.
Generic livestock offspring precede the specifically bovine herds and sheep flocks. Revise only the first cattle to livestock, leaving the later cattle for boon.
Wearing down in every city continues until the high fortified walls of trust fall, with affliction in the given cities repeated.
The siege leads to eating one's own sons and daughters; both straitness and distress and the enemy's agency remain explicit.
The tender man's grudging look concerns brother, wife of his bosom and remaining children, with the family list retained.
Begrudging any flesh to those relatives is linked to no food remaining and the siege in all cities.
column3: The relationship of baskanei in 28:54 to hoste dounai here is idiomatic; begrudging supplies its contextual negative force without claiming a separate Greek negation before give.

column2: The woman's extreme delicacy is described by her unaccustomed foot, then her grudging look concerns husband, son and daughter.
Afterbirth and the child she bears are both named before secret eating, with the repeated siege explanation retained.
The condition concerns all written law and fearing the honoured, wondrous name identified as the Lord your God.
Extraordinary plagues, great and astonishing, and grievous enduring diseases retain the selected descriptive sequence.
Egypt's grievous suffering returns and cleaves; the plural they after the collective suffering is retained rather than silently regularized.
Even unwritten infirmity and plague are included, extending beyond the immediately enumerated threats.
Few in number reverses the stars-of-heaven multitude because the divine voice was not heard.
The paired divine rejoicing in doing good/multiplying and in destroying is retained without softening either side.
Dispersion runs from one end of the earth to the other and leads to unfamiliar wooden and stone gods.
No rest or place for the foot accompanies a faint heart, failing eyes and wasting soul, with all three inward afflictions retained.
Life hanging before the eyes, day-and-night fear and lack of assurance remain three coordinated descriptions.
Morning longs for evening and evening for morning, with the repeated fear and sights supplying the reason.
Return to Egypt is by ships and by the prohibited road; sale as male and female slaves and the absence of a buyer remain together despite their tension.
The Moab covenant heading stays at the selected 28:69 boundary and is distinguished from the covenant at Horeb.
